scene tsukiokasonthecouch1
Two girls on a couch in a house in a town that won’t stop growing — but they were safe within these walls from the clutches of those ever-expanding tendrils that no one ever sees!
They were both very pretty. They were both very kind! But the heart of one was much brighter than the heart of the other.
And while the color of a heart does not dictate the way and speed with which it beats, it does paint a mostly accurate picture of whether or not someone can be trusted.
Would “trust” be an important element to this conversation? Who knows?! For they already trusted each other. But did they really?
A mother’s relationship with her daughter can be quite difficult to understand, you know? That said, however — there is nothing like it in the world.
And the events that transpire upon this couch are sure to show you just that.
: You wanted to speak with me, Touka?
: Correct, Mother. I had some questions about Sensei that I believe only you will be able to answer.
: Oh? There’s nothing I can tell you that he can’t, dear.
: True. But approaching him about the matter is...difficult, considering our relationship. And I know you to be a woman of great influence and great knowledge.
: My dearest daughter, there’s no need for such generosity. Please speak with me as if we’re gossiping over mimosas at Le Coin Français.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch2
: Is that really okay?
: Of course, dear. You are my first-born child who I’m sure will one day have a very similar conversation in a very similar position on this very couch.
: If you are to become me, you must first stop holding me to such ridiculous standards. I really am just another one of the girls at the end of the day.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch3
: I apologize for the unwanted formality, then. Yes — let us speak as two women deep in the throes of brunch at a cozy French cafe.
: How is your French, by the way? Have you been practicing?
: Let us speak not of language until my questions have been answered or acknowledged, Mother.
: You haven’t been, have you?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch4
: I barely have time for anything anymore between my classes here and at school. Which doesn’t even touch upon how much time I’ve needed to spend on the apartment building and Yasu lately.
: A Tsukioka always has the time, Touka. You’d be doing yourself a kindness to remember that.
: Perhaps you are correct...
scene tsukiokasonthecouch5
: But still...that has naught to do with the matter at hand.
: Then ask away, dear. But do so with tact. I’d hate to belittle someone I have so much respect for behind his back.
: Why do you have so much respect for him, Mother? Without making him sound like a terrible person...Sensei is, by all accounts, a really terrible person.
: Ha! I suppose that, by conventional means, that’s true. But we are not a conventional family, Touka. We don’t share the same values as those outside of our walls.
: Which is why, if you are here to expressly ask for permission to sleep with him-
scene tsukiokasonthecouch6
: Mother, no!
scene tsukiokasonthecouch7
: Still you refuse to believe that’s what you want? I’m so perplexed, dear. If I were you, I’d be all over that man like Isaac Burns Murphy on Buchanan at the Kentucky Derby.
: That...is another matter entirely! It is not what I wish to discuss.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch8
: Okaaaay! I’m just saying, dear...wait any longer and someone else in the family might get to him first.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch9
: You...wouldn’t.
: How do you know I’m not speaking about your sister?
: But Tsukasa is-
: To be wed to someone else. I know.
: That...is not what I was going to say. But yes, I suppose that much appears to be true as well.
: Regardless, can we not speak of the potentialities of my teacher’s sex life within Tsukioka Manor and, instead, speak of his existence in this city as a whole?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch10
: And what is that supposed to mean, daughter?
: Recent events within New Hope Cathedral have just...led me to believe that Sensei may possibly bear the same sort of...divine significance as Yasu.
: Divine significance...what an interesting choice of words.
: Forgive me, but I’m unsure of how else to describe their shared connection to a seemingly forgotten sect of spiritual wisdom.
: Wisdom implies that there is some amount of truth to it, Touka. It’s all but more fanatical nonsense at the end of the day — the same way it is with all religion, dear.
: Perhaps...but that doesn’t change the fact that there are many things about their respective existences that never cease to perplex me.
: And I know that you’ve gone to the efforts of researching Sensei’s past, so if there’s something of significance that you may have uncovered...
: Something that could help me cultivate a better...understanding of who he is, I would greatly appreciate if you shared that knowledge with me.
: Touka darling, if you want to fuck him, just tell him. All these extra steps you’re taking are making me dizzier than a 1922 Madeira would.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch11
: This is not about sex! Why do you keep making everything about sex?! Can I not show interest in him apart from carnal desire?! Is that truly so bad?! So wrong?!
: It’s not wrong...It’s just boring. You have to admit, the man is attractive. Experienced too.
: I don’t care about that! I care about knowing why you’re, for lack of a better term, obsessed with him! He’s a commoner! He’s nothing! He’s-
: Important.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch12
: In what way?

: Would you believe me if I told you I’d known him since before you were born? Or that he is somehow the key to winning the space war? Or maybe that he is your long lost older brother! Ooh, that’d be fun!
: No! I would not believe any of that. And I ask, no — I beg that you save jokes like this for a moment where I am not caught between a rock and a hard place!
: If only the hard place was his thick, throbbing member...
scene tsukiokasonthecouch13
: What in the world has gotten into you?! Why are you acting this way?! It’s like you’re barely my mother at all!
scene tsukiokasonthecouch14
: Oh, I’m the one who isn’t myself? Please.
: What is that supposed to-
scene tsukiokasonthecouch15
: Your charade is as flimsy as a wet paper bag, darling. Why not drop the act now and show me who you really are?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch16
: Ooooh, interesting! I recognize those eyes.
: How did you know?...
scene tsukiokasonthecouch17
: You think I wouldn’t recognize someone masquerading as my own daughter?
: There’s nothing more important to me in this entire world than my girls, dear. Surely your mother is the same, is she not?
: That’s...um...
: Let’s cut to the chase — what do you want? What use do you have for Akira?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch18
: Hah...
scene tsukiokasonthecouch19
: What do you think about this place, Miss Tsukioka?
: Are you happy here?
: Why, I haven’t heard that question in quite some time. Shows you the type of people I commonly associate with, does it not?
: Just answer the question, please. I’ve already broken the rules by revealing myself. I shouldn’t stay any longer than I need to.
: How can I answer what can not be answered at all? Just tell me what you need and I’ll see to it.
: Would you believe me if I told you I wanted to save the world?
: Which one?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch20
: Oh, you’re good. I guess coming here really was the right idea after all.
: You must be somewhat desperate if that’s the case, though. It’s been decades since the last time I encountered one of you.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch21
: I am. But please keep it a secret because I’m really trying to shake things up.
: Ooh, I love secrets! Do tell.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch22
: Ahem! I’ve been practicing this pitch for quite some time, so get ready to have your mind blown.
: A business proposition then?
: Something like that.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch23
Blah, blah, blah. Then some stuff happened. Busy now! Gotta go! Bye!
: Do the two of you ever feel as if someone is talking about you behind your back?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch24
: Every time I sneeze.
: Talking about a creature as insignificant as me would be a waste of time and energy! That’s why I only think about God!
: Why do you ask, Touka?
: I just...can’t help but feel like I’m having some strange sort of...out of body experience right now. Like I’m in two places at once.
: Is the other place a diner? I hope it’s a diner. I’m really hungry. I want to be there too.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch25
: It’s certainly not a diner, but...I’m not quite sure where it is. Or what.
: It’s nowhere specific, surely. It’s more of just a...state of being or...not being, maybe. Like I’m caught between two separate planes of existence at once.
: Uh-oh! I think Yasuyasu might be rubbing off on you! Tickle tickle tickle!
: Aah! Stop it, Karin! It feels like there are ladybugs beneath my skin!
scene tsukiokasonthecouch26
: Whatever the case, I’m sure it will go away shortly. Perhaps it’s just my turn to start experiencing intermittent possession and this is my body’s way of warming me up to it.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch27
: One of us! One of us!
: Possession? What do you mean it’s your turn to start being possessed? Isn’t that a horror movie thing?
: Yes, but- oh! Perhaps I should be Linda Blair for next year’s Halloween party? Regardless, it both is and isn’t a “movie thing.”
: And I imagine you’ll bear witness to it soon enough if you continue to spend time with Yasu and me as she experiences bouts of something possession-adjacent quite frequently.
scene tsukiokasonthecouch28
: This little bug?! Getting all scary like that?! Doubt it! She could never even hurt a fly! Could you, Yasu?
: I could not! For I am but one of them and bringing harm upon myself or my kind would be worth nineteen days in a tub of acid.
: Just say no next time, kay?
: It’s not just me either! It’s Sensei too! We have a “gift!”
scene tsukiokasonthecouch29
: Sensei?
: He’s extra special! He can see things! I merely become them and carry words from up above to those undeserving who live closer to the ground than the sky!
: So he...what?
: You’ve never witnessed something seemingly take him over before?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch30
: ...What?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch31
: Probably just one more case of you not experiencing what essentially everyone else in our class has due to less exposure to him.
: It’s practically common knowledge to all of us at this point that he has bouts of...decreased identity. Though, the reasons for this remain as elusive to me as ever.
: Perhaps I should refer him to Yasu’s doctor as well? Their cases are slightly different, but I’m sure that-

: You...You’ve seen this before, Touka? This...possession thing? What’s it like? Can you tell me? I...I’m just curious! It’s not like...I’ve actually seen it, but...you know, if I had, I’d obviously want to know!
scene tsukiokasonthecouch32
: You’d be better off asking Ayane than me. He seldom acts that way in my presence. Probably because he thinks I’m his mother and is comforted by my existence. I hate it.
: Ayane...yeah.
: She...knows stuff about him. I’ll...ask her.
: You have witnessed it, haven’t you?
scene tsukiokasonthecouch33
: No!
scene tsukiokasonthecouch34
: ...maybe.
: Well, on the off chance you haven’t, you will soon enough. And I do ask that you don’t hold it against him as I imagine there’s no one who hates it more than he does.
: You...think he’s a good person then?
: Now...I don’t know if I’d go that far. But I don’t think he means any harm.
: Yeah...
scene black
: Maybe...he doesn’t...
Back! Sorry. What did I- oh, darn. Over already?
Guess I’ll just get out of here, then! Later!
Hope you enjoyed being one of the girls!
